title: Descent into the Realm, Forsaken
description: A Java neoforge survival mod, intergrating custom weapons, a seasonal system, different boss progression, culinary aspects, new creatures, and much more.
body:
#   Descent into the Realm, Forsaken

  **Descent into the Realm, Forsaken** is a **java 1.21.8 neoforge** based mod surrounding a world where you must fight for your survival and earn your freedom, overseen by entities you cannot understand.

## What is added?

  The mod provides a **moderately difficult realism survival experience**, with aspects like over 25+ new custom weapons with different unique functionality, a 6 stage seasonal system that effects farming aswell as inflict different effects, lengthly culinary endevours with new soups, dishes and effects with them aswell as a few culinary reworks, a hidden story and lore, currently 1 new boss and main game progression with 3 new creatures with much more ot come and many materials. Lastly aswell as a few custom systems relating to the world this mod is set in, involving a skill path-like that allows for personal progression and pathways, resulting in different ways of playing.
![Desolate Biome, The Banish Clifflands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae23e1c5d475ea6e0b146756bf5d6a34abdf0dd4_0.webp)
  The mod is built to be very diverse with many differnt indepth process to take part in, with **hours of playtime** avalible. The mod may be difficult but it is also rewarding, with many oppurtunities to "rule the realm" in your own way.
![Tables and Chairs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/004ec8bd8cb9aeb7b346fb5cb8b3a9388c6b3b58.png)
### How to get started

  The mod must be ran in a Neoforge 1.21.8 client, or server, and once all has been installed and is running properly, the mod pretty much effects the whole game; not being limited to a single dimension or part of the world. A tip to keep in mind is: ponder crafting recipes frequently, as many recipes will lead to another. Exploration is also a fair way of experienceing the game as the currently-single biome added will provide plently of new items and materials. Im sure from there you will find out mroe and more, eventually leading up to defeating the first modded biome boss, a large serpent of the Banish, the Aanx Kharothyice.

### Connections and Community

  Aswell as the mod, I also host a community **discord server** related to the mod, where aditional help installing the mod can also be found along with the bug tracker for fixing issues: [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/fT8KN3n3MZ)

  If your truely curious about whether you want to go through the hassel of trying this mod, look into my **Youtube channel** where I play through the MC Testing Server with the mod installed: [Youtube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@theanthemprince)
